sql.query: INSERT INTO tbl_contract_deliveries (tenantId,contractId,deliveryMethod,deliveryStatus,recipientName,recipientEmail,subjectSnapshot,pdfFileNameSnapshot,pdfSha256Snapshot,sentDate,notes,createdByUserId) SELECT gc.tenantId,gc.id,'external','recorded',NULLIF(TRIM(:recipientName),''),TRIM(:recipientEmail),NULLIF(TRIM(:subject),''),gc.pdfFileName,gc.pdfSha256,COALESCE(STR_TO_DATE(NULLIF(:sentDate,''),'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i'),CURRENT_TIMESTAMP),NULLIF(TRIM(:notes),''),:userId FROM tbl_generated_contracts gc WHERE gc.id=:contractId AND gc.tenantId=:tenantId AND gc.status IN ('issued','sent') AND gc.pdfStoragePath IS NOT NULL AND gc.pdfSha256 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(:emailCheck) REGEXP '^[^@[:space:]]+@[^@[:space:]]+[.][^@[:space:]]+$' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_tenant_modules tm INNER JOIN tbl_modules m ON m.id=tm.moduleId AND m.moduleCode='CONTRACT_GENERATION' AND m.isActive=1 WHERE tm.tenantId=gc.tenantId AND tm.status IN ('ACTIVE','TRIAL')) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr WHERE utr.userId=:roleUser AND utr.tenantId=gc.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1)

UPDATE tbl_generated_contracts SET status='sent',modifiedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=:contractId AND tenantId=:tenantId AND status='issued' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_contract_deliveries d WHERE d.contractId=:contractId2 AND d.tenantId=:tenantId2 AND d.createdByUserId=:userId)
